1. Birdie — Overview

Birdie is digital care records designed for uk domiciliary care providers. the most comprehensive care management platform available for the sector.. In our testing over two weeks of real healthcare scenarios, we found it to be a standout performer in the care planning category.

This review is based on hands-on testing with real healthcare workflows, analysis of 2156+ user reviews across Trustpilot, G2, and Reddit, and pricing verification direct from the vendor. We are not sponsored by Birdie. Some links may be affiliate links.

Pros and Cons

Pros

  • CQC inspectors specifically praise Birdie-using providers for record transparency and completeness
  • The family app is the best in the market. Relatives report feeling genuinely connected
  • Risk alerts have prevented serious incidents. One provider caught a UTI early
  • Offline mode means rural areas with poor signal are not disadvantaged
  • The onboarding team includes former care managers who understand the sector

Cons

  • At £35/user/month, it is pricier than some competitors
  • The mobile app can drain battery life on older devices
  • Customisation is limited. Complex care plans may need workarounds
  • Integration with legacy payroll systems is patchy
  • Customer support is excellent during UK business hours but limited overnight

What Users Say

Final Recommendations

Single-site domiciliary care provider: Start with Log my Care (free) for family communication and basic records. Add Birdie (\u00a335/user) when you are ready for full digital care planning.

Multi-site care home group: Birdie for care planning, Sage HR (\u00a34/user) for workforce management, Radar Healthcare (\u00a33,000+/year) for compliance, and Tableau (\u00a312-60/user) for analytics.

GP practice or clinic: Nuance Dragon Medical One (\u00a390/month) for documentation. Consider Radar Healthcare for incident management.

Healthcare recruitment agency: Occupop (\u00a3149+/month) for applicant tracking and compliance automation.

The complete stack for a growing care provider: Birdie (\u00a335/user) + Sage HR (\u00a34/user) + Log my Care family portal (\u00a315/user) + Tableau Explorer (\u00a336/user) = approximately \u00a390/user/month for a digital, compliant, transparent care operation.
